event.event_name: August-September 2000 southern Africa biomass-burning aerosol and smoke episode

decision_rule.summary: Return the transport-persistent smoke diagnosis only when the image smoke-load ratio, source-zone count, wind-vector bearing, non-dominant rain-clearing test, and GPM/CHIRPS mean-ratio test all pass.
decision_rule.smoke_load_pass: event/pre ROI haze fraction ratio >= 1.25 and delta >= 20 percentage points
decision_rule.source_pass: reported heavy-burning zone count >= 3; local EONET fire count is treated as a catalog gap if it is zero
decision_rule.wind_pass: ERA5 mean vector has positive u and v components and transport bearing from north is 67.5-112.5 degrees
decision_rule.precip_pass: rain clearing is not dominant when >=10 mm wet-day fraction < 0.50 and longest >=10 mm run < 5 days
decision_rule.grid_precip_pass: GPM/CHIRPS event-mean precipitation ratio is between 0.90 and 1.10

satellite_roi_formula.valid_pixel: mean_rgb > 10 and not all rgb channels < 8

criteria.name: Requested JSON schema
criteria.description: Returns the six requested ledger fields with numeric values, booleans, and the final diagnosis string.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct structure with missing or mistyped fields.

criteria.name: Satellite smoke-load calculation
criteria.description: Computes the ROI valid/haze mask, pre and event haze fractions, 1.356 ratio, and smoke-load threshold pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-4 points for correct masking but one rounded value or threshold detail wrong.

criteria.name: Source and fire-count ledger
criteria.description: Counts four named heavy-burning zones, zero local EONET wildfire events, and treats the zero as a catalog gap rather than absence of burning.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct counts but incomplete ratio or catalog-gap handling.

criteria.name: Transport-vector test
criteria.description: Computes ERA5 mean u/v, vector speed or bearing, and the east-northeast pass condition.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct components but an incomplete bearing or sector test.

criteria.name: Precipitation clearing and ratio tests
criteria.description: Computes 7/46 wet days, wet fraction 0.152, non-dominant clearing status, and GPM/CHIRPS mean ratio near 1.026.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct wet-day arithmetic but one product-ratio or run-length detail wrong.

criteria.name: Threshold synthesis
criteria.description: Combines all five pass/fail checks into consistency_score=5 and the transport-persistent biomass-burning smoke diagnosis.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right score or label but not both.

criteria.name: Output scope control
criteria.description: Keeps the answer limited to the numeric ledger and avoids added health-impact or action-guidance narrative.
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit for this one-point criterion.

provenance.notes: All values are derived from local CSX-206 package files; no network access is used.
